next_step: Run 2-week POC: ingest 5M sample tickets, run embeddings+ANN retrieval, cross-encoder rerank; deliver latency/cost/quality report
notes:
Summary: Bridgewell builds a SaaS support desk platform used by retail + fintech customers. Primary ask: reduce live-agent handle time via ticket deflection + agent assist. Focused on embeddings + ANN retrieval + reranking to push top-5 suggestions to agents and the self-serve help center.

Key metrics and targets: 
- Index scale: ~25M canonical support artifacts (tickets, KB articles, transcripts). Current POC slice: 5M.
- Ingestion cadence: ~50k new items/day, need incremental embed pipeline and warm-up strategies.
- Latency SLOs: agent UI P95 for retrieval+rerank <= 200ms (ideal 150ms). Self-serve search P95 <= 300ms.
- Cost sensitivity: target end-to-end cost per user query <= $0.04 (including embedding + ANN + rerank). Finance pushing hard on cost model.
- Quality goal: top-5 reranked answers precision/recall lift vs baseline >= 18% (business KPI: deflection uplift and fewer agent escalations).

Technical preferences / constraints: 
- Two-stage retrieval desired: sparse BM25 to filter, ANN (HNSW/FAISS) on 1536-d embeddings for candidate generation, then cross-encoder reranker for final top-5.
- Prefer Redwood-managed hosting for speed of integration, but must run in VPC with private endpoints; evaluating Dedicated vs Private for EEA data residency later.
- Embedding model: want to test Redwood-verified 1536-d and a lower-cost 768-d quantized variant for cost tradeoffs.
- Reranker model: GPU-backed cross-encoder for top-5; fallback policy needed to smaller reranker if GPU capacity constrained.
- Storage: retention 7 years for audit; deletion workflows for GDPR.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdowns, per-route latency, and per-query traceability required for SRE / Legal.

POC plan discussed on call: 
- Week 0: sample corpus (5M tickets) delivered by Bridgewell.
- Week 1: Redwood ingest + embed; configure ANN index and baseline retrieval.
- Week 2: run reranker experiments, measure top-5 quality and latency, run cost model simulations.
- Week 3: present report + recommended config (batching, quantization, autoscale).

Quotes / call snippets: 
- CTO: "If p95 climbs above 250ms agents will not adopt — throughput matters as much as accuracy."
- Head of CS Ops: "We need solid A/B data tying top-5 quality to deflection rate. If it's not measurable, Finance won't sign."

Escalations and security: 
- Security review kicked off 2026-02-20; Bridgewell's InfoSec requires SOC2 and SSO/SAML plus KMS integration.
- Network team requested private VPC peering + IP allowlist; PCI customers later will require on-prem option.

Open questions for Redwood team: 
- Can rerank+retrieve for top-5 be served under P95 200ms for 25M index with requested redundancy?
- Expected cost per query at scale for the proposed 1536-d model + cross-encoder rerank?
- Differences between Dedicated and Private for incremental ingest ops and residency?

Attached stubs: drive links + Fireflies notes for two calls. POC timeline firm but Finance needs cost-per-query estimate before SOW sign-off.
